title: Fractals in Jackson Pollock's paintings

tellings.quote: uh go go go look this up there is a scientific American uh article Yeah. >> called Order in Pollock's Chaos.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, on Jesse Michels' podcast, points listeners to a Scientific American article called "Order in Pollock's Chaos" by the scientist Richard Taylor. Jorjani says it shows that the painter Jackson Pollock's famous drip paintings contain fractals, patterns that repeat at every scale, suggesting hidden order inside what looks like random splatter.
